title: Vampire Vape Desserts Caramel Latte 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Caramel Latte by Vampire Vape Desserts Koncept range recreates the familiar warmth of your favourite coffee shop treat, combining deep, roasted Coffee flavour with a drizzle of sweet Caramel and a layer of smooth, steamed milk. This rich and satisfying vape brings together rich coffee notes and creamy sweetness, offering a comforting option for coffee fans. Blended at a 70VG/30PG ratio, this high-VG shortfill is designed for sub-ohm vaping, delivering thick vapour and a smooth, full-flavoured experience. Each bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 120ml bottle, with space to add two 10ml nicotine shots if preferred. Produced in the UK and fully TPD-compliant, Caramel Latte is part of the Vampire Vape Desserts range — a collection of sweet, comforting e-liquid blends inspired by classic dessert and beverage flavours. Also available in Freebase 10mls and Concentrates.
